name: Doodh Peda
steps: Warm 30 ml milk and steep crushed saffron in it for 10 minutes. Grease a plate lightly using a little of the measured ghee.
Crumble the mawa finely into a heavy pan and mix with the remaining milk. Add sugar and the remaining ghee, then place over low heat and stir until evenly combined.
Stir continuously for 8–12 minutes, scraping the base and corners. Add saffron milk and cardamom once the mixture becomes a thick paste.
Continue cooking gently until the mixture pulls away as a soft mass. Cool a small dab on a plate: it should roll without sticking badly.
Transfer to the greased plate and cool until comfortably warm, about 15 minutes. Do not overcook to a dry crumble or the pedas will become hard.
Divide into twelve balls, flatten gently and press chopped pistachios into shallow central dents. Cool completely before refrigerating in a covered container.
tips: Use a heavy pan and scrape the base regularly to prevent scorching.
passiveTime: 10 minutes saffron soaking and 15 minutes cooling
notes: Makes twelve small saffron milk pedas using milk powder for a practical home method. Refrigerate and use within 3 days.
